provenance.edgeDefinition: characters linked from the same paragraph of a wiki character article, the article's subject counting as present throughout
provenance.weightSemantics: count of shared article paragraphs across all character articles

attribution.title: Stormlight Archive Wiki — character articles
attribution.creator: Stormlight Archive Wiki contributors
modifications: Read the wikitext of the character articles through the MediaWiki API; no article text is reproduced.
Tied two characters when one paragraph of a character article links to both, counting an article's subject as present throughout their own article; weight is the number of such paragraphs.
Dropped non-narrative sections (gallery, references, notes, trivia, quotes, behind the scenes) and sections about other canons.
Took each tie's books from the {{Ref}} chapter citations in the paragraphs behind it.
Resolved wiki redirects to characters and used them, with the infobox aliases, as aliases.
Took gender, title, occupation, Radiant order, people, species and noble house from the article infobox as discrete facts.
Dropped ties weaker than 1 and characters with fewer than 2 ties, then kept the largest connected component (701 nodes and 2584 ties in, 579 and 2468 out).
Added a normalised rank per tie endpoint so thickness reads relative to each character's own ties rather than raw counts.
Computed a force-directed layout for the full graph, used by the reveal animation.
